messages.author: caaac2dc0aae28b8
messages.subject: accessing data from object of class unmarkedFitColExt
parts:
Hello;

I’m working on a simulation function to generate new data from an existing colext model fit (object of class unmarkedFitColExt). I need to get the data and there appears to be functions to coerce unmarked objects to dataframes.  However, I can’t figure out how they work or how to get access to them. When I print the unmarkedMultFrame object returned by getData(), it has the yearlysitCovs, but when I try to coerce the object to a dataframe it doesn’t include them. Can anyone help me figure out what's going on?  I realize I can access the data componenets directly using getY(), obsCovs(), siteCovs() and yearlySiteCovs(), but if there is a nice method already written to put these all into a dataframe then I’d rather use it!
Thanks,
Eric Stolen

attr(,"package")
[1] "unmarked"
> Data.retreived <- getData(fm1)

messages.author: 403be63af7ebf220
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] accessing data from object of class unmarkedFitColExt
parts:
Hi Eric,

It looks like the as(umf, "data.frame") method for unmarkedMultFrames drops yearly site covariates. We should fix this. In the meantime, you can do something like what is done in the show method:


> setMethod("show", "unmarkedMultFrame",
+     function(object)
+ {
+     df <- as(object, "data.frame")
+     ysc <- yearlySiteCovs(object)
+     if(is.null(ysc)) {
+         cat("Data frame representation of unmarkedFrame object.\n")
+         print(df)
+         }
+     else {
+         T <- object@numPrimary
+         yscwide <- lapply(ysc, matrix, ncol=T, byrow=TRUE)
+         df <- data.frame(df, yscwide)
+         cat("Data frame representation of unmarkedFrame object.\n")
+         print(df)
+         }
+ })
[
